summary: Join our professional training on AI in environmental monitoring. Equip yourself with the knowledge to tackle ecological challenges using innovative technology.
lede: AI in environmental monitoring helps environmental and sustainability professionals turn satellite, sensor and field data into insights about environmental change. The training covers preparing and validating data, interpreting AI outputs for climate, land, biodiversity, water and pollution monitoring, and using alerts and visualisations to support reporting and response decisions, with attention to bias, limitations and human oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who depend on environmental data for planning, regulation, or sustainability decisions. Whether you are involved in monitoring, reporting, or impact assessment, this course equips you with the tools to make data-driven decisions.
audience: Natural resource and land management officers
modules: Foundations of AI in Environmental Monitoring
AI for Climate and Weather Monitoring
AI in Land Use, Forestry, and Biodiversity Monitoring
Water, Air, and Pollution Monitoring Using AI
Risk Detection and Environmental Early Warning Systems
AI for Environmental Reporting and ESG
Ethics, Bias, and Limitations of AI in Environmental Monitoring
Integrating AI into Environmental Programs and Policies
prerequisites: Basic understanding of environmental science and data handling. Familiarity with digital tools is beneficial but not required.
